Title: Real-Time Object Detection: Phone Camera, YOLO, & ROS 2
Description: Developed an end-to-end real-time object detection pipeline within the ROS 2 framework. Integrated a mobile phone camera stream (via ros2-android-sensor-bridge) with a YOLOv5n object detection node (yolo_ros). Engineered the pipeline to handle image format conversions (compressed to raw using image_transport). Built a custom Python node using OpenCV (cv2) and cv_bridge to subscribe to detection results and draw bounding boxes/labels directly onto the video stream for live visualization in rqt_image_view. Configured the entire system using ROS 2 launch files. This project demonstrates skills in ROS 2 system integration, computer vision, multi-node communication, and debugging complex robotics pipelines

Title: ROS 2 Simulated Object Detection with TurtleBot3 in Gazebo
Description: Developed and integrated a complete live object detection pipeline within the Gazebo simulation environment using ROS 2. This project involved launching a custom Gazebo world with a simulated TurtleBot3 Waffle, streaming its virtual camera feed via ROS 2, processing the stream with a YOLOv5n object detection node (yolo_ros), and visualizing the real-time detections (bounding boxes, labels) onto the video using OpenCV and CV_Bridge. The annotated video was published and viewed live using rqt_image_view, demonstrating a full perception loop from simulated sensor data to actionable visual output. The project reinforced core ROS 2 concepts, simulation mechanics, and highlighted practical considerations like computational resource management for real-time AI in robotics.
